narrative: A Rose bill, black-letter, brought across and not a thing you stood in front of. The title is the whole of the printed line you read. No author. No price. No face. The same bill. The margin where a receipt would be written is blank. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the title and did not cross to the Rose.

entities.name: a second part of Caesar
entities.context: Shown on bill in A second part of Caesar
